summary: Lakehouse was articulated as an open direct-access architecture pattern spanning warehouse and advanced analytical workloads.
Substrait advanced a cross-language typed relational-plan interchange with explicit extensions and incomplete/pre-1.0 boundaries.
Velox demonstrated a reusable vectorized execution engine shared across distinct analytical systems.
ADBC introduced a standardized Arrow-native client API distinct from both SQL semantics and Flight SQL transport.
Flight SQL expanded portable Arrow result transport and explicit session/metadata commands.
Delta protocol features made deletion vectors an editioned table-protocol capability rather than an engine-local assumption.
Iceberg REST catalog work made the engine/catalog seam a published protocol surface.
Connector-aware dynamic filtering made runtime-derived scan pruning and its finite thresholds explicit.
Hudi's timeline and file-slice specifications kept merge-on-read and copy-on-write lifecycle mechanics explicit.
Substrait physical relations exposed join, exchange, aggregate and window property contracts while retaining consumer-defined logical/physical classification.
Arrow format evolution added editioned carrier capabilities while preserving that physical layouts do not own value semantics.
The SQL/Foundation technical corrigendum reinforced that language semantics are editioned and provider adoption must be independently bound.
